title: OceanVeil Streams Kamui: He's Behind You Anime's English Dub
content:
The English cast includes:

• Diana Garnet as Shizuka Mimizuka

• Jesse Inocalla as Kamui

• Nina Nikolic as Oichi

• Mia Paige as Inagawa

• Sneha Kumar as Kyōko

• Aife as Narrator

• Roo Ryder as Female Client / Former Owner

• Aria Pierce as Teke-Teke

• Mana T. Johnson as Miss Mary

• Amanda Parker as Slit-Mouthed Woman

• Dré Ayala as Male Client

• Meredith Nudo as Kokkuri

• Jessica Warner as Pomade Boy / Female Spirit

• Erin Tenelle as Yui

• Zoe Lee as Long-Neck

• Shay-Ki Fullalove as Andrew

• Angela Tran as Gap Woman

The English staff includes:

• Executive Producer: Jonathan Hinga

• ADR Director: Kevin Frane

• ADR Assistant Director: Zack Maher

• Production Assistant: Amanda Parker

• Time Coding: Jasper Bear

• ADR Engineers: Jack T. Westlake / Zack Maher / Andrea Stewart

• Mix Engineer / Mastering: Steve Warky Nunez

• Adaptation: Laura K. Welsh

• Localization Supervisor: Kevin Frane

• Talent Sourcing: No Studio In Particular (Reece Bridger)

• Public Relations: Paul Davey

• Marketing: Mana T. Johnson

• Quality Assurance: Shane Tay / Brian Rollins / Sean Tay

• Subtitles: Danny Miller / L.L.

The anime premiered on Tokyo MX on July 3 at 25:30 (effectively, July 4 at 1:30 a.m. JST), and will air on BS11 on July 7. OceanVeil began streaming the anime on Friday at 9:30 a.m. PDT (12:30 p.m. EDT).

OceanVeil describes the story:

Shizuka Mimizuka is a self-proclaimed "ordinary" high school girl with a massive, terrifying catch—she has a unique constitution that naturally acts as an absolute magnet for ghosts and malevolent spirits. Recognizing her supernatural allure (and her lightning-fast running skills), the famous psychic Kamui hires her to be his official assistant... and live bait. Kamui boasts overwhelming spiritual power and looks like a drop-dead gorgeous heartthrob, but he harbors a bizarre, total-degenerate secret: he only gets turned on by ghosts and apparitions! His methods for purifying the supernatural are entirely unprecedented, wildly intimate, and incredibly lewd. Can Shizuka ever achieve her dream of a normal school life while being dragged into a parade of bizarre paranormal incidents? The curtain rises on a "super" ecchi exorcism comedy!

Takumi Tsukumo ( Divergence Eve , Misaki Chronicles original creator) is directing the anime at Zero-G , and ZG-R . Motoshi Chūjō ( Ai: Tenchi Muyo! episode scripts, Maji de Otaku na English! Ribbon-chan: Eigo de Tatakau Mahō Shōjo the TV ) is in charge of series scripts, and Toshinari Yamashita ( Amazing Nurse Nanako , Divergence Eve ) is designing the characters.

KOTOKO performs the anime's ending theme song "SAY-BYE!!"

WWWave Corporation 's Deregula anime label is producing the anime.

Eroki and Konoshiro debuted the manga in March 2020 on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app. Shogakukan published the manga's 13th compiled book volume on August 10.

title: Viz Media, Japan Society Screen World Premiere of Hirayasumi Anime on October 7
content:
The anime will premiere in January 2027 in Japan on the NHK General channel. Viz Media also announced in English a 2027 release.

Kei Suezawa ( Fate/Grand Order The Movie Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot - Wandering: Agateram , FLCL Progressive ) is directing the anime at Production +h. Naoyuki Asano ( Urusei Yatsura , Keep Your Hands Off Eizouken! , Mr. Osomatsu ) is designing the characters. Mika Nishimura ( Dead Dead Demon's Dededededestruction , Typhoon Noruda ) is the art director. Kaori Sawada ( What Did You Eat Yesterday? , When Spring Comes ) is composing the music.

Viz describes the story:

At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn't have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn't be happier. Hiroto's breezy attitude isn't easy for everyone to understand, though. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people around him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life.

Shinzō launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine in April 2021. Shogakukan published the manga's ninth compiled book volume on July 30, and the series has over 1.1 million copies in circulation worldwide. The manga was nominated for the 15th Manga Taisho awards in January 2022, ranked #18 in the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook in December 2022, nominated for the 27th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in February 2023, and nominated for Best Continuing Manga Series in the 2nd American Manga Awards.

The series also inspired a live-action series , which premiered on NHK in November 2025.

Denpa has licensed Shinzō's Holiday Junction collection of short manga. The book contains seven one-shot manga. Shogakukan shipped the book in Japan in July 2016.

title: Crunchyroll to Debut the Next Big Korean Webcomic Anime This Fall – Watch Trailer
content:
The Fall 2026 season is almost here, and Crunchyroll is gearing up for many new anime debuts, making the final season of 2026 an exciting one. A trend has emerged in the anime industry recently, beginning with Solo Leveling ‘s anime adaptation. Based on the Korean webcomic of the same name, the anime became one of the biggest hits in the modern anime industry, and since then, many studios have hopped on the trend by adapting other series as well. The Summer 2026 season itself saw the debut of such an anime, Tomb Raider King, which naturally garnered comparisons with Solo Leveling .

Now, this Fall is going to bring Overgeared , the anime adaptation of the popular Korean webcomic of the same name. Produced by J.C. Staff, the anime adaptation of Overgeared is scheduled to premiere on September 27, as part of Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 anime lineup . The anime is going to be available with subtitles and other dubs, including Latin American Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, German, French, Castilian Spanish, Italian, Arabic, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Polish, Thai, and Tagalog. A new trailer for the upcoming anime has been released, which already summarizes what this anime is going to be about, and there is no doubt that Solo Leveling fans are going to love every bit of it.

Crunchyroll’s New Korean Webcomic Anime Is Set to Be Solo Leveling ‘s Replacement in Fall 2026

The upcoming Fall Korean webcomic anime, Overgeared , features a 26-year-old who has the worst luck of all and is in debt. To change his life, he joins the popular VR game Satisfy under the name Grid, which affects his real-life status and fame. However, after a single turning quest, he becomes the heir to a legendary blacksmith. Now, with his newfound power, Grid is ready to conquer the world, but a comical twist reverts his status to zero, forcing him to start from scratch. As a blacksmith, Grid begins to forge his own weapons and armor, gearing up to change his life for good.

The premise undoubtedly feels very similar to Solo Leveling , as does the leveling-up pattern of its protagonist, which is similar to Jinwoo’s. This anime is going to emphasize more on the gaming element that Solo Leveling employs, but in a subtle real-life way, with Jinwoo going on side quests to level up and becoming an overpowered character in a game. The anime’s core premise, with its character going on a self-development journey, is what makes it awfully similar to Jinwoo’s. Both of them come from nothing, but they get a sudden opportunity to go on a redefining journey that brings out the best in them.

Solo Leveling ‘s manhwa popularity has created a subculture of webcomics of the same type, and now its anime adaptation has done the same as well. Overgeared seems to be the newest series following the trend, and so far, the trailer looks promising. However, J.C. Staff has had a bad reputation, all thanks to One Punch Man ‘s poor anime adaptation . That said, Overgeared ‘s arrival on Crunchyroll with a perfect adaptation could help the studio redeem some of its reputation by presenting it as a replacement for Solo Leveling in its absence in Fall 2026.

title: Earth Defense Force 6.2 Invaders From Another World Game Launches on March 18
content:
D3Publisher announced at the Tokyo Game Show 2026 on Friday that it will release Earth Defense Force 6.2 INVADERS FROM ANOTHER WORLD, an updated version of its Earth Defense Force 6 game, on March 18, 2027.

The Earth Defense Force 6 game launched in Japan in August 2022 for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5. (The game had been delayed and was previously slated for the end of 2021.) The game launched in North America in July 2024 after a delay . Clouded Leopard Entertainment also released the game in English in Asia in 2024. The game's story takes place three years after the Earth Defense Force 5 game .

D3Publisher released the Earth Defense Force 5 game digitally on PS4 in the West in December 2018. The game launched in Japan in December 2017, and launched on PC via Steam in July 2019. PQube released a physical version of the Earth Defense Force 5 game for PS4 in North America and Europe in September 2020.

D3Publisher launched Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 , a sequel to the Earth Defense Force: World Brothers spinoff game, for PS5, PS4, and Switch in May 2024. The game launched in the West in September that same year.

title: Even the Student Council Has its Holes! TV Anime Reveals Ending Theme in 2nd Main Promo Video
content:
The staff for the television anime of Muchimaro 's Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! ( Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! ) four-panel manga revealed the second main promotional video and ending theme song artist on Friday. The below video previews Akari Nanawo 's ending theme song "Pi."

The series stars:

• Shōgo Sakata as Mizunoe Ume

• Haruka Shiraishi as Hisako Kotobuki

• Miyu Tomita as Komaro Michinoku

• Hiyori Kōno as Tan Otori

• Shizuka Ishigami as Arisu Terui

• Yumi Uchiyama as Satomi Hiratsuka

Naoyuki Tatsuwa ( Ōmuro-ke , Gourmet Girl Graffiti , Nisekoi - False Love , Promise of Wizard ) is directing the anime at Passione , Ryo Imamura ( ONIMAI: I'm Now Your Sister! ) is designing the characters and is the chief animation director, and Masahiro Yokotani ( Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! , Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- , Beelzebub , The Devil Is a Part-Timer! ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts.

Other staff members include:

• Main Animators: Kay Yu, Kona Ming (name romanization not confirmed), Asatoshi Oki, mockingbird, SanzashiAme, and Mushiki (name romanization not confirmed)

• Art Director: Hiromichi Itō

• Color Design: Arisa Komatsu

• Director of Photography: Junpei Takatsu

• Editing: Michi Takigawa

• Sound Director: Satoshi Motoyama

• Music: Tomoki Kikuya

Sangatsu no Phantasia performs the opening theme song "Kaze no Naka wa Hashirukkya Inai."

Seven Seas publishes the manga in English and describes the story:

In a student council filled with weirdos, one new member is about to have a hell of a school year! Mizunoe Ume just wanted to avoid repeating a grade when he joined the student council. After all, it seemed like an easy fix to his current academic problems. But then, he met his fellow council members. Each of them is eccentric in their own way—one's an airhead, another's scary, one's secretly a pervert, but all in all, they're just really weird! Yet somehow, they're also oddly cute and endearing. Which means Mizunoe is stuck with them and all the chaos they bring to the table. Get ready for a slice-of-life manga that's irresistibly charming, quirky, and a little bit naughty!

Muchimaro launched the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in 2022. Kodansha shipped the 13th compiled book volume on August 17. Seven Seas shipped the first volume on September 8. K MANGA also publishes the series in English digitally.

The manga received an animated ad in July 2024. The manga won in the print category of the ninth Next Manga Awards (Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Taishō) in 2023.

title: The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me TV Anime Reveals October 6 Debut in Video
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kazami Sawatari and illustrator Achiki 's The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me ( Shiotaiō no Satō-san ga Ore ni Dake Amai ) light novel series revealed on Friday the anime's second key visual, main promotional video, theme song artists, and October 6 debut.

Masayoshi Ōishi performs the opening theme song "Sugar Salt" and HoneyWorks feat. Hoshikawa Sara performs the ending theme song "Hatsukoi Reply" (First Love Reply).

The anime will debut on AT-X on October 6 at 8:30 p.m. and will air later that evening on Tokyo MX , BS-TBS , and WOWOW . The anime will also air on CBC and MBS . The series will stream in Japan on d Anime Store and U-NEXT starting on October 6 at 10:30 p.m.

The anime stars:

• Hiiro Ishibashi as Sōta Oshio

• Miku Itō as Koharu Satō

• Miyu Tomita as Rinka Sudō

• Chiaki Kobayashi as Ren Misono

• Yoshino Aoyama as Shizuku Misono

• Hisako Kanemoto as Mayo Nezu

• Yasunori Matsumoto as Seizaemon Oshio

• Yūki Wakai as Madoka Murasaki

Fumihiro Yoshimura ( My Wife Has No Emotion , Jungle Emperor Leo / Hon-o-ji ) is directing the anime at Tezuka Productions , and Takashi Aoshima ( The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You ; Himouto! Umaruchan ; Uzaki-chan Wants to Hang Out! ) is in charge of the series scripts. Daisuke Okushima is designing the characters, and Shun Narita ( 365 Days to the Wedding , The Girl in Twilight , Harmony of Mille-Feuille ) is composing the music.

The coming-of-age romantic comedy depicts the first love between two people — except each one has unrequited love for the other. Sōta Oshio works at a café. He learns one day that Koharu Satō, a classmate known as "cold Satō-san," is actually just shy and awkward. From that day forward, the distance between the two quickly narrows …

Shogakukan 's Gagaga Bunko imprint began publishing the light novel series in 2019, and the 13th volume will ship on October 16. Kaya Tetsuyama launched the manga adaptation on the Manga ONE and Ura Sunday services in May 2020, and Shogakukan will publish the 11th compiled book volume on October 9.

Shogakukan 's NOVELOUS app is releasing the series in English under the title The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me .

title: Suikoden Anime Reveals Third Trailer, Ending Theme Song and October 3 Premiere
content:
Suikoden: The Anime , the anime adaptation of Suikoden II , revealed the ending song and an October 3 premiere in a third trailer. The anime was previously announced in March 2025 as an adaptation of Suikoden II , along with a new mobile game for the franchise. It was previously confirmed that Episode 1 will be a 1-hour special. The ending theme song is “closed eye sun (feat. Honoka Takahashi)” by Koji Nakamura, and you can hear it in the new trailer alongside amazarashi’s opening theme.

The anime recently expanded the voice cast with three more members, and it now includes:

• Toshiki Kumagai as Riou

• Ayumi Hinohara as Nanami

• Simba Tsuchiya as Jowy Atreides

• Akihiro Mine as Rowd

• Tsukino Chikasada as Pilika

• Ayumu Murase as Luc

• Takeo Otsuka as Shu

• Yoshino Aoyama as Apple

• Masato Niwa as Mukumuku

• Taku Yashiro as Luca Blight

• Chika Anzai as Jillia Blight

• Jun Kasama as Culgan

• Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Seed

• Megumi Han as Leknaat

• Shota Hayama as Gengen

• Ryunosuke Watanuki as Rikimaru

• Saaya Hitomi as Rina

• Mizutama Umino as Eilie

• Yusuke Sasaki as Bolgan

• Hitoshi Yamanoi as Agares Blight

• Miyuki Sawashiro as Anabelle

• Hiroki Sakai as Jess

You can also see the main visual for the anime:

The company’s recently-established in-house studio KONAMI animation is handling the animation production, with Yuzo Sato as the director. Steam describes the story of the second game:

Our story’s hero and his friend Jowy are members of the Unicorn Youth Brigade, which participated in a drawn-out border dispute between the Highland Kingdom and the City-States of Jowston . A few months earlier, a truce agreement was signed between the two forces, both of which were happy to see an end to the fighting. However, hidden under the momentary peace the fires of a new war continued to smolder…

Production Details

• Original Work: Konami Digital Entertainment

• Director: Yuzo Sato

• Production & Planning: KONAMI animation

• Production Committee: Suikoden Production Committee

Originally released in 1998 as part of the Suikoden series, Suikoden II is a turn-based RPG developed by Konami Digital Entertainment. The game follows a young hero caught in a war between rival nations and is known for its large cast of recruitable characters, political narrative, and tactical battles.

title: Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san? Anime Teaser Trailer Revealed
content:
The first teaser trailer for the anime Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san? has released ahead of its January 2027 release date . Studio SynergySP is in charge of the animation, with Yasuaki Fujii as director. Keiichiro Ochi is handling the series composition, Majiro is the character designer, and Alisa Okehazama is the music composer.

The trailer shows Kuroki after he is seated next to Mai Chihara at the start of a new semester. Although his classmates describe Chihara as a “landmine” girl, Kuroki begins discovering unexpected sides of her as the two spend time together.

Sayumi Suzushiro voices Mai Chihara, while Kazuki Ura voices Kuroki. The main voice cast consists of:

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Mai Chihara

• Kazuki Ura as Kuroki

• Maaya Uchida as Chinatsu Iwakura

• Tomokazu Sugita as Hibiya

• Daisuke Ono as Kazami

You can watch the teaser trailer below.

The manga series is drawn by Ryon. It began on Comic Smart’s Ganma! website in June 2021 and has released 9 volumes as of July 2026. Seven Seas will start releasing the manga in English on September 29, 2026. They describe the story: Don’t judge a book by its cover or a girl by her fashion taste! A slice-of-life rom-com manga about wrong impressions and looking beyond appearances. The manga that inspired the upcoming anime It’s the start of a new semester, and high school junior Kuroki finds himself seated beside the girl everyone whispers about: Mai Chihara. With her gothic fashion, jet-black hair, and intense stare, Chihara is said to be a “landmine” girl or jirai-kei, the hyper-feminine, dark aesthetic often associated with yandere tendencies and unstable personalities. But when Kuroki accidentally draws Chihara’s attention, he discovers she isn’t nearly as unstable as people claim. Beneath the intimidating aura is a surprisingly sweet girl… if a little weird. Hesitantly, Kuroki begins to learn more about Chihara and her strange quirks. Is there more to her than her volatile reputation? Or is all the dark clothing just a red flag in disguise?

title: 'Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san?' TV Anime's Teaser Trailer Streamed
content:
The official website for the television anime of Ryon 's Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san? ( Jirai nandesu ka? Chihara-san ) manga revealed the anime's teaser promotional video on Friday.

The anime stars:

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Mai Chihara

• Kazuki Ura as Kuroki

• Maaya Uchida as Chinatsu Iwakura

• Tomokazu Sugita as Hibiya

• Daisuke Ono as Kazami

Yasuaki Fujii (episode director for Teasing Master Takagi-san , Too Cute Crisis , Aikatsu! ) is directing the anime at Synergy SP . Keiichirō Ōchi ( Aikatsu! , Summer Pockets , The Quintessential Quintuplets ) is overseeing the series scripts. Majiro ( Macross Delta , UniteUp! ) is designing the characters, and Arisa Okehazama ( The Apothecary Diaries , Jujutsu Kaisen , DIGIMON BEATBREAK ) is composing the music at King Records .

Other staff members include:

• Art Director: Hisae Arimoto

• Color Key Artist: Emi Kadono

• Compositing Director of Photography: Naotaka Watanabe

• Sound Director: Daiki Hachimaki

• Sound Effects: Akiko Mutō

• Sound Production: IMAGICA EMS

Seven Seas Entertainment has licensed the manga for English release, and it describes the story:

It's the start of a new semester, and high school junior Kuroki finds himself seated beside the girl everyone whispers about: Mai Chihara. With her gothic fashion, jet-black hair, and intense stare, Chihara is said to be a “landmine” girl or jirai-kei, the hyper-feminine, dark aesthetic often associated with yandere tendencies and unstable personalities. But when Kuroki accidentally draws Chihara's attention, he discovers she isn't nearly as unstable as people claim. Beneath the intimidating aura is a surprisingly sweet girl… if a little weird.

Ryon launched the manga on the GANMA! service in June 2021. The manga won a "Next Impact Comic" award at the second Rakuten Kobo E-book Awards in 2024.

title: Psikyo Arcade Shooters Get Psikyo Memories Collection Release
content:
Edia announced on Wednesday that it is developing Psikyo Memories , a collection of '90s arcade scrolling shooter games by Psikyo. Edia also revealed the collection will include Strikers 1945 .

The company's pamphlet at its booth at Tokyo Game Show 2026 lists the game will launch in 2027 for PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2, and lists it will include Gunbird .

The game collection will also feature a gallery of archive materials from the games.

Psikyo's arcade shooters have had previous collection releases on the PlayStation 2, PlayStation 4, and Switch. The latest release is Psikyo Shooting Stars Alpha and Psikyo Shooting Stars Bravo , which launched on the Switch in 2020, and on the PS4 in 2022.

Psikyo announced a Psikyo Shooting Collection release for the PlayStation 5 in 2020, but has since not released it. The collection would have included Strikers 1945 , Strikers 1945 II, Strikers 1999, Gunbird, Gunbird 2, Gunbarich, Samurai Aces Episode I, Samurai Aces Episode II: Tengai, Samurai Aces Episode III: Sengoku Cannon, Dragon Blade, Zero Gunner 2 , and Sol Divide: Sword of Darkness .
author: ANN
